items.title: Axis Securities, Emkay retain BUY on Gravita after Q2 FY27; targets Rs 2,270 and Rs 2,100
items.text: Axis Securities kept BUY with a target of Rs 2,270 and Emkay Global kept BUY with Rs 2,100 after Gravita's Q2 FY27 (revenue +38% to Rs 1,427 cr, adjusted EBITDA +28% to Rs 143 cr, PAT +6% to Rs 102 cr). Lead recycling volumes fell 11.3% YoY, attributed to raw-material shortages, with management expecting improvement from Q3 FY27. Gravita has earmarked Rs 865 cr of capex through FY29 for new verticals including copper and lithium-ion battery recycling; the article gives no further battery detail, so the Li-ion leg remains a small part of the thesis. The stock rose about 4% to an intraday high of Rs 1,400.75.

sources.title: Gravita India shares rise 4% as Axis Securities, Emkay retain BUY rating

items.title: Gravita Q2 FY27: revenue up 38% to Rs 1,427 cr, PAT up 6% to Rs 102 cr; lead volumes fall
items.text: Gravita reported Q2 FY27 (filed 27 Oct) revenue of Rs 1,427 crore (+38% YoY), EBITDA of Rs 143.37 crore (10.04% margin vs 10.80%) and PAT of Rs 102.01 crore (+6%, margin 7.15% vs 9.27%). Lead volumes fell to 39,203 MT from 44,187 MT, while the new copper vertical added 4,236 MT. The coverage does not discuss Li-ion recycling beyond listing lithium as a vertical, so the battery-metal leg remains immaterial to earnings and the stock still trades on lead, aluminium and copper.
